channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Janja volta ao palco e canta em ato de Lula no Rio
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva performed the 'Tapete Vermelho' jingle alongside pastor and gospel singer Kleber Lucas during Lula's campaign rally at the Moça Bonita Stadium in Bangu, western Rio de Janeiro. The event served as a show of support for the PT candidate's reelection, gathering supporters in the city's west zone.

item.title: Em Barretos, Flávio exalta agro e diz que voltará à Festa do Peão com Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended the Festa do Peão in Barretos, advocating for agribusiness and announcing his return in 2027 as president, accompanied by Jair Bolsonaro. The event featured Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and emphasized the primary sector's role in the economy.

item.title: Isabela Kalil: Desembarque do Centrão muda o lugar dos Bolsonaro na direita
item.description: Anthropologist Isabela Kalil assesses that the center-right's distancing from Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) candidacy signals a shift in the Brazilian right-wing, highlighting the failure of trying to use bolsonarism without submitting to it. She argues that the Bolsonaro family has hegemonized the political field while allies gave up containing it, and the 2026 election marks a new turning point, with Flávio running for president weakened by Jair Bolsonaro's imprisonment.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula states that, coming from extreme poverty and lacking educational opportunities, he became president three times, describing it as a miracle. He suggests his profile reflects Brazilian reality and society.

item.title: Sem Lula nem Flávio, primeiro debate das eleições tem esvaziamento inédito
item.description: The first presidential debate of the 2026 election cycle takes place without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, marking an unprecedented emptiness with only low-polling candidates participating. The absence of PT and PL leaders is strategic to avoid concentrated criticism, while Bandeirantes keeps empty podiums to highlight their decision.

item.title: Esnobado por Lula e Flávio, debate tem grande interesse do eleitor, mostra pesquisa
item.description: The first presidential debate on Band, at 8 PM on the 23rd, will take place without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, despite 86% of voters planning to watch. Their absence contradicts voter interest, particularly among the undecided.

item.title: Coreógrafo vira maior doador do partido de Renan Santos em 2026
item.description: Choreographer Alberto Broner Worcman, known as 'Gingi', is the largest donor to the Missão party that nominated Renan Santos for the 2026 presidential race, contributing BRL 152,000 between February and April. The party declared BRL 1.8 million in donations, including BRL 1.2 million from collective funding.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, os debates ainda importam? O que dizem os especialistas
item.description: The first presidential debate of 2026 will take place without the presence of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, the frontrunners in the polls. Lula stated he will not participate in debates where 'nonsense is spoken', while Flávio said he will only attend if Lula is present. Both are expected to participate only in the final debate, organized by TV Globo on October 1st.

item.title: Lula tem 22 dos seus 30 ex-ministros como candidatos em 12 estados em 2026
item.description: Lula has 30 former ministers in his third term, 22 (73%) of whom will run for office in 12 states during the 2026 elections. Notably, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and several former cabinet heads are joining Lula's ticket. This lineup reflects strong coalition-building and organized parallel support for re-election.

item.title: Jantar na casa de Moraes com Lula e Alcolumbre teria tratado de como fragilizar Mendonça
item.description: Reports suggest a dinner involving Lula, Alcolumbre, and Moraes at the STF minister's house included discussions targeting Minister André Mendonça, who serves as rapporteur in high-profile cases. The information reached Mendonça's office, fueling speculation. The story is behind a paywall with limited public details.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio, debate na Band terá Caiado, Zema, Renan e Cury
item.description: The Band presidential debate, scheduled for Sunday (August 23, 2026), will feature Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury, while Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will not participate. The format keeps empty podiums symbolically for the absent candidates, with topics including public security, the economy, and mental health, as all contenders advocate for public spending cuts.

item.title: Planalto pressiona, mas senadores admitem votação da 6x1 após eleição
item.description: Despite pressure from the Presidency, senators admit that the vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale may be postponed until after the October elections due to lack of time for processing. The matter remains in the Senate's CCJ and will only be discussed on September 3rd, while Senate President Davi Alcolumbre maintains control over the text's progress.

item.title: Sua vida, como vai?
item.description: A poll of 765 readers reveals that 78.8% believe their lives have improved over the past four years, while 21.2% say they have worsened. The content includes political and cultural commentary such as electoral analysis, racial self-declaration trends, and a satirical cartoon featuring Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Urnas eletrônicas são testadas em eleição simulada no Maranhão
item.description: A simulated election will take place in Paulino Neves, Maranhão, to test the electronic voting booth systems and processes before the official elections in October 2026. Led by the TSE and TRE-MA since 2004, the initiative involves 15,000 voters and 96 poll workers, evaluating the security, agility, and infrastructure of the electronic voting system.

item.title: 438 deputados federais tentam reeleição
item.description: 438 of the 513 federal deputies submitted to the TSE are running for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies in October. The PL (77) and PT (57) lead the ranking of parties with the most candidates seeking re-election, followed by União Brasil (49).

item.title: 438 deputados federais tentam a reeleição para a Câmara em 2026
item.description: Out of 513 federal deputies, 438 intend to run for reelection to the Chamber of Deputies in October 2026, according to a Diap survey based on TSE records. The PL and PT parties lead the ranking with 77 and 57 candidates seeking reelection, respectively, followed by União Brasil with 49. The first round of elections is scheduled for October 4th, with the second, if necessary, on October 25th.

item.title: Lula e Flávio fazem guerra de preços de comida nas redes sociais
item.description: The Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaigns are clashing on social media over basic food prices, using videos and posts to criticize or counter inflation narratives. The battle centers on economic issues, with both sides selectively highlighting data to attack each other.

item.title: De PL a PCO: 51 candidatos a governo já criticaram o STF ou pediram impeachment de Moraes
item.description: 51 out of 194 2026 gubernatorial candidates have criticized the STF or called for Moraes' impeachment, including names from PL and PCO. PCO leads with 18 critical candidates, followed by PL with 10. These criticisms aim to attract Bolsonaro voters and question the alleged judicial dictatorship in Brazil.

item.title: Lula divide chapas ao Senado com 10 governadores, e Flávio, com 6; veja os cenários em cada Estado
item.description: The 2026 elections are set to intensify polarization in the Senate, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro dividing slates across dozens of states. While Lula has backing from governors, mainly in the Northeast, Flávio leads numerically with more endorsed candidates. The alliances reflect the fragmentation of the national political landscape.

item.title: Band e ‘Estadão’ promovem primeiro debate entre os candidatos a presidente em 2026; saiba como será
item.description: Grupo Bandeirantes and Estadão host the first 2026 presidential debate with four confirmed candidates, while Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are absent. The debate will be streamed live at 8 PM on Estadão’s digital platforms. The forum gains prominence due to low voter recognition of candidates and the absence of leading figures.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cria comissão evangélica para organizar ato do 7 de Setembro na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) formed an evangelical commission to organize the September 7th parade on Paulista Avenue, aiming to rally popular support after the underwhelming turnout at the campaign kickoff event in Copacabana.

item.title: Erosão democrática: a presença das organizações criminosas nas eleições
item.description: The article examines how criminal organizations influence electoral processes in Latin America through illegal funding, corruption, and territorial control to condition democratic outcomes. Cases like Mexico illustrate the complexity of the relationship between illicit economies and politics, particularly in Brazil, where the reach of these organizations exacerbates democratic erosion.

item.title: Marçal promete recuar de candidatura se não tiver segurança jurídica
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) states he will not run for the Planalto Palace in 2026 unless his candidacy is judicially approved, avoiding harm to Lula in the first round. He could aid Lula by drawing votes from Flávio Bolsonaro, but his sub-judice candidacy may be annulled post-election, reducing valid votes.

item.title:
Urgência
ignorada
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian electoral campaign neglects the climate crisis, with few concrete proposals on decarbonization. President Lula stands out with a more robust plan, but maintains contradictions by promoting oil exploration in the Amazon. Flávio Bolsonaro follows a denialist environmental stance, threatening green organizations.

item.title: Planalto vê abertura com Trump para renegociar tarifaço após eleição
item.description: The Brazilian government moves forward in renegotiating U.S. tariffs after the phone call between Lula and Trump, which reopened commercial dialogue. A meeting between trade representatives of both countries is scheduled for next week to discuss the 25% and 12.5% rates on Brazilian exports. The resumption of talks follows months of deadlock and increased tensions between the governments.

item.title: Dois filhos (Lulinha e Flávio Bolsonaro), dois pesos e duas medidas
item.description: The article contrasts Fábio Lula (Lulinha), whose record is free of business deals or candidacies, with Flávio Bolsonaro, accused of not explaining the whereabouts of R$ 61 million received for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. It criticizes media bias and questions the focus on Lulinha to attack Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Flávio, son of a former president, remains silent on the case for 100 days, while Lulinha avoids controversies.

item.title: Contradições do STF
item.description: DataFolha poll shows a tight presidential race, as suspicions involving President Lula’s son gain traction. Wiretaps suggest lobbyist Robert Luchsinger acted as a proxy for ‘Lulinha’, with ties to the president’s chief of staff and the Ministry of Health.

item.title: Irregularidades em adesivos eleitorais é a 3ª mais denunciada no DF
item.description: Reports of irregular electoral stickers in DF account for 18.6% of national occurrences, with 12 records in the first six days of campaigning. The practice, though common, must follow TSE rules such as a 0.5m² limit and prohibition in service vehicles.

item.title: Em tempos de 'zap', pega mal telefonar? E como mandar áudio sem gafe? Veja a nova etiqueta do celular
item.description: A study by Anatel reveals that Brazilians are increasingly abandoning traditional phone calls on their mobile devices, favoring messages and voice notes. The article highlights the shift in communication habits and the need for new digital etiquette. Full access requires registration at the source.

item.title: Band promove 1º debate presidencial neste domingo. Veja quem participa
item.description: Band hosts the first 2026 presidential debate with Caiado, Zema, Renan and Cury; Lula, Flávio and Marçal are absent.

item.title: Rivais, mas não no meu santinho: prefeitos de oito das dez maiores cidades de Alagoas apoiam tanto Lira quanto Renan
item.description: Mayors from eight of the ten largest cities in Alagoas publicly support both Arthur Lira (PP) and Renan Calheiros (MDB), rivals in the Senate race, as part of a strategy to preserve influence and secure federal resources. This informal alignment reflects a logic of protecting municipal interests, making it difficult for local leaders to choose sides.

item.title: Desdobramentos dos casos Master e Lulinha ampliam divergências entre Mendonça e Gonet
item.description: The investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) escalated tensions between Minister André Mendonça and Attorney General Paulo Gonet, particularly regarding jurisdictional competence. The PGR advocates transferring the case to lower courts, while Mendonça may keep it at the STF due to its linkage to the INSS scandal.

item.title: Menções a Lulinha e Marcola desgastam governo nas redes, mostra levantamento
item.description: Investigations involving Lulinha and Marcola weaken the federal government, with Lulinha at the center of 31.4% of mentions regarding the INSS scandal. Bites data shows that Bolsonarism uses the issue to attack Lula's campaign, particularly with Flávio Bolsonaro and allies.

item.title: Voto nos estados: com Cleitinho na frente, polarização perde força na eleição de Minas
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) leads the gubernatorial race in Minas Gerais with 32% of voting intentions, leveraging an outsider discourse and support from non-aligned voters. His campaign proposes ending vehicle seizures for IPVA default and renegotiating state debt, while maintaining a critical stance toward the party's national leadership.

item.title: Com Lula na lista, octogenários batem recorde nas urnas, mas representam menos de 1% dos candidatos
item.description: The 2026 election sets a historical record with 99 candidates aged 80 or older, including President Lula da Silva. They represent less than 1% of total candidates but reflect population longevity and the strategy of keeping well-known figures. The increase has been continuous since 2002.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad transformam corrida de São Paulo em disputa por números
item.description: The São Paulo gubernatorial race features Tarcísio and Haddad using data-driven campaigns and debates to differentiate themselves. While Tarcísio highlights infrastructure and economic numbers, Haddad presents regional and national indicators.

item.title: Eleições 2026: mais de 6.900 candidatos não declararam bens
item.description: TSE data reveals that 6,933 out of 20,682 candidates in the 2026 elections did not declare assets to the electoral court, accounting for 33.56% of all candidacies. Some candidates declared negligible assets, such as R$0.01, mostly linked to checking account deposits.

item.title: "Bilionários por engano": saiba quem são os candidatos que erraram registro
item.description: Three candidates in the 2026 elections declared billions of assets to the TSE but later claimed typographical errors. Pablo Marçal (PRTB) corrected from R$7.4 billion to R$149.9 million; Maria Lúcia Soares Viana (PSol-TO) corrected from R$2.07 billion to approximately R$2 million; and Dr. Giorgia Michelleti (PSDB-AC) corrected a house from R$1.1 billion to R$1.1 million. Their teams confirmed the discrepancies were due to mixing up thousands and millions.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP neste domingo (23/8)
item.description: This Sunday (August 23rd) marks one week into the São Paulo gubernatorial race, with seven candidates competing for the seat. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead the polls, followed by Vera Lúcia, Carlos Machado, Izadora Dias, Policial Edjane, and Vivian Mendes. Each candidate has scheduled campaign events and activities for the day.

item.title: Bolsonarinho, Lulinha e o efeito do prestígio de Lula na eleição
item.description: Datafolha survey shows Lula's significant lead over Bolsonaro, contradicting rumors of a tight race. Lula's prestige may influence undecided voters in the 2026 election.

item.title: Tentativa de polir credenciais fiscais de Lula é frustrante
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan was highlighted by Lula to support his reelection campaign and convince markets of new fiscal credentials. Despite efforts to calm banks and fund managers, market anxiety and volatility in indicators such as the dollar and government bonds suggest the strategy is not achieving the expected results.

item.title: Federações partidárias neutras na corrida presidencial reúnem 3,7 mil candidatos nas eleições
item.description: Five neutral party federations fielded 3,766 candidates in the 2026 elections, focusing on contests for the National Congress due to Federal Party Fund resources. Only the PT, PCdoB and PV Federation led by Lula and the PSol and REDE alliance declared support for a presidential candidate, while others remained neutral, including União Brasil and Progressistas.

item.title: Mais de 900 candidatos mudaram declaração de cor ou raça no TSE entre 2022 e 2026
item.description: Between 2022 and 2026, 909 candidates who previously ran changed their declared race or color in the TSE, accounting for 14.4% of the 6,315 who kept the same profile. The most common shift was from brown (parda) to white (branca), with 322 cases, followed by white to brown, with 317. However, specialists emphasize that these changes alone do not confirm misconduct, as factors like identity perception, administrative errors, or party mediation may play a role.

item.title: Eleições 2026: 404 candidatos usam títulos religiosos em nome de urna
item.description: TSE data reveals that 404 candidates in the 2026 elections used religious titles on the ballot name, such as pastor, brother, or priestess, concentrated mainly in legislative races. Religion is leveraged as a political agenda and electoral platform, reflecting demand for faith-based proposals. The phenomenon also includes figures like Michelle Bolsonaro, who, though evangelical, did not adopt a religious title on the ballot.

item.title: VÍDEO: Influenciador pode fazer campanha eleitoral?
item.description: Digital influencers can express their political opinions on social media, but they cannot receive financial benefits or promote content in a paid manner. The TSE banned practices like 'cutting contests', which pay creators to spread campaign content. The g1 series explains how new technologies impact the 2026 elections.

item.title: André Mendonça será o novo Sergio Moro?
item.description: André Mendonça took over the Ministry of Justice after Sergio Moro's departure in 2020, being accused of using the position to target critics and opponents of Jair Bolsonaro. His performance sparked debates about judicial independence and the political use of the ministry.

item.title: Coragem ou tiro no pé? Canadá tem cacife para desafiar Trump e retaliar tarifas dos EUA ‘dólar por dólar’?
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney chose to retaliate against the new 50% tariffs imposed by the United States, canceling negotiations and announcing 'dollar-for-dollar' measures starting September 8th. This decision escalates the commercial dispute between the two nations, which exchange roughly $900 billion annually, potentially leading to a spiraling trade war.

item.title: Na Festa de Barretos, Flávio diz que vai "resgatar" agro brasileiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used the Barretos rodeo festival to defend agribusiness, claiming he will 'recover' the sector. He was accompanied by Tarcísio de Freitas and other right-wing politicians. He also declared war on 'drug traffickers' starting January 2026.

item.title: PF vê plano de amiga de Lulinha para conta fora do Brasil, diz revista
item.description: The Brazilian Federal Police is investigating plans by Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Lula (Lulinha), to open a bank account and company in Liechtenstein, suspected of hiding illicit funds. Investigations also reveal cash usage and instructions to conceal sums in suitcases and wardrobes. Luchsinger and Lulinha face probes at the Supreme Court on suspicion of corruption and money laundering.

item.title: Lula tem 60% dos votos no 1º turno no Piauí, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on August 22, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading voter intentions in Piauí with 60% in the first round. In a potential runoff, Lula reaches 68% against 24% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). The survey was conducted between August 18 and 21, 2026, with a margin of error of ±3 percentage points and 95% confidence level.
